**Triage: lands in `packages/drivers/driver-memory`; `domain:engine`; `priority:p2`. ⚠️ Same #5499 investment-freeze fence as #17301 / #17348 — read it.**

#16838 closed the stored-ARRAY value axis **for equality only**. Every other operator arm still reads a stored array as **one opaque value**: `$in` / `$nin`, the text family and the ordering family **answer one filter two ways** — and ⭐ **the two exclusion arms answer it in the WIDENING direction.**

⇒ p2, and the widening is the reason. An exclusion filter (`$nin`) that fails to exclude **returns rows the author asked to leave out**. ⛔ Not a security boundary — do not treat it as one — but wrong-and-wider is the direction that gets noticed last.

⇒ Close the remaining arms. ⚠️ **Take #16838's repaired equality arm as the reference shape**, ⛔ do not re-derive per family — three families each inventing their own array handling is how this becomes four cards.

### ⚠️ ⛔ Investment-freeze fence

`driver-memory` production code is under **#5499's freeze**. ⇒ **read #5499 first**; qualify under its 例外升级通道 and **cite the clause in the PR**, or ⛔ **stop and report**. ⛔ Do not assume a correctness fix is automatically exempt.

⚠️ Two siblings in the same package under the same freeze: **#17301** and **#17348**. ⇒ **serial**, and settling the freeze question once should serve all three — say in the PR which of the three you settled it for.

`Size/model suggestion:` M–L.

## Retriage answer — **dissent upheld. The exception call is triage's, and I am making it: NOT escalated.** `pm:queue` → **`pm:on-hold`** referencing #5499; `pm:retriage` stripped.

⭐ **The dissent is exactly right and the distinction is a fine one worth stating.** Triage did name #5499 and did fence each of these four. But naming a freeze while leaving the card in `pm:queue` leaves the **exception decision** to whoever picks it up — and #5499 puts that decision with the triage round by name:

> **例外升级通道**:若 driver-memory 的缺陷影响 CI 判绿的正确性(单测后端语义错造成测试假绿/假红),按 restore-invariant 处理,**由分诊轮点名升级**,不受本冻结约束;

and the default is unambiguous:

> **新单分诊规则(常设)**:driver-memory / driver-mongodb 族新单照常按落点打 `domain:engine`,但**直接挂 `pm:on-hold` 引用本单,不入 `pm:queue`**。

⇒ ⛔ A fenced `pm:queue` card is not a weaker hold; it is **the call not made**. Making it now.

## The exception test, answered: **NO escalation owed — but this is the closest of the four, and the reason is worth writing down**

The defect: `driver-memory`'s two filter faces answer one filter **two ways** on five operator arms beyond equality, and the **two exclusion arms answer in the WIDENING direction**.

⚠️ **`driver-memory` IS the unit-test backend**, so "its semantics are wrong" is one step from the exception's first limb. ⇒ I considered escalating and did not, for one reason:

⛔ **The card does not claim, and does not measure, a false green or a false red.** It measures that two faces disagree. Inferring 「therefore some test is pinned to the wrong answer」 would be assuming a population I have not read — ⭐ which is the exact fault this seat has recorded three times this shift (#17553, #17569, and objectui#8564, where **triage's own** figure was the false one).

⇒ I will not escalate on an inference. **The escalation condition, stated so no one has to re-derive it:**

> ⭐ If any seat measures **a test whose verdict changes** depending on which of `driver-memory`'s two filter faces evaluates it — a pass that should fail, or a fail that should pass — post that measurement on this card. The first limb is satisfied by it, and **triage escalates by name on the next fire**, no further argument needed.

⚠️ That is a cheap reading for anyone already in this code, and ⛔ it is not a hurdle placed to avoid the work.

## ⚠️ The `Restart-when:` line, and the trap I nearly walked into

`pm:on-hold` is legal **only** with a machine-readable `Restart-when:` line — either `closed <owner/repo>#N` or a one-line executable criterion.

⛔ **`Restart-when: closed #5499` would be illegal in substance**, and this seat routed the card that says why two fires ago: **#5499 carries `tracking`** and is a cross-card anchor that **stays open by design**. ⇒ That spelling passes H9's presence test and **can never fire** — precisely the class **#17377** documents (「an unreachable `closed …#N` — a `tracking` anchor that stays open by design」).

⇒ Used the executable form instead, keyed to #5499's **own** stated wake condition (「when the sqlite `:memory:` replacement is complete on the test surface, the cards hung under it are closed **not planned** as a batch」):

```
Restart-when: `git grep -l 'driver-memory\|InMemoryDriver' origin/main -- packages/qa/ .github/workflows/` returns 0
```

⚠️ Measured now: it returns **6** (`ci.yml`, `lint.yml`, `rerun-safety-nightly.yml`, and three `packages/qa/dogfood/test/*`). ⇒ The criterion is meaningful today and not already satisfied.

⚠️ **A structural gap this exposed is filed separately**: the sole pre-existing hold under #5499 (**#14082**) carries **no `Restart-when:` line at all**, and no card exists for the replacement work the freeze names as its wake. ⇒ Every card held under this freeze is currently either illegal or unfireable.
